app.tagline: A quiet place to look back together, and to thank each other.
lang.label: Language
landing.title: Aloha
landing.body: This is where {hui} does its reviews. Each time, you write about your own work and about a few coworkers, then {director} reads it all and sits down with each person to talk story.
landing.howto: To get started, open the link {director} sent you by text or email. It brings you straight to your list.
landing.expired: That link has expired or is no longer active.
landing.newlink: Lost your link? Type the email or phone number {director} has for you. We use it to find you, then email you a fresh link. We do not send texts.
landing.offline: We could not reach the server. Check your signal and try again.
dash.none: No review is open right now. Mahalo for checking in.
dash.letterBody: {director} shared a letter about your work. Read it, and write back if you like.
dash.teamBody: {director} shared a report on the whole team from this review: what we do well, where we struggle, and ideas for what comes next. No names.
dash.offline: You are offline. Anything you write is saved on this phone and will sync later.
card.quickDone: Quick version done, come back for the rest.
review.anon: Anonymous. Your name is never stored with this answer.
review.anonMahalo: Anonymous unless you check the box to sign it.
review.selfNote: These are your own words about your own work.
review.sign: Sign my name to this mahalo so they know it came from me
review.placeholder: Type here, or tap Talk and say it out loud
review.recording: Recording {time} of 3:00. Tap Stop when you are done.
review.transcribed: Here is what we heard. Fix anything that is off.
review.audioQueued: Recording saved on this phone. It will turn into words when you are back online.
review.transcribeFailed: We kept your recording but could not turn it into words, so {director} can still listen to it.
review.noMic: We could not use the microphone. You can type instead.
review.savedLocal: Saved on this phone, will sync when online
review.required: This one needs an answer, by typing or talking.
review.missing: {n} question(s) still need an answer before this is done.
review.doneBody: Your answers are in. You can come back and change them until the review closes.
review.quickDoneBody: Quick version done. Come back for the rest when you have more time.
review.closed: This review is closed, so answers can no longer change.
me.title: Your letters
me.none: Nothing has been shared with you yet.
me.reflectHelp: Write back to {director}. What landed, what surprised you, what you want to add.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.load: We could not load this page. Check your signal and try again.
error.login: Please open your link again to continue.
error.storage: This browser would not save your answer. Copy it somewhere safe.
signout.unsent: Some answers have not reached the server yet. Signing out deletes them from this phone. Sign out anyway?
nav.label: Your pages
moon.note: Moon names follow one common count. Local practitioners may count differently.
dash.asksBody: A coworker asked how something went from your side. It takes a minute.
dash.links: Your page has your letters, goals, and mahalo.
landing.requestSent: If you are in an open review and have an email on file, a fresh link is on its way to your inbox. If nothing arrives in a few minutes, ask {director}.
landing.requestManual: Please ask {director} for a fresh link.
goals.help: Your two or three goals until your next review, usually set after your talk story. Mark them as you go.
goals.placeholder: Something you want to grow into before your next review
mahalo.none: No mahalo yet. They will show up here.
mahalo.public: Show it on the mahalo board for everyone
mahalo.boardHelp: Public thanks from across the team, newest first.
mahalo.boardEmpty: Nothing here yet. Be the first.
feedback.askHelp: Ask about something specific, like a workday or a project. They get a note to answer, and their answer comes back here and helps your next letter.
feedback.placeholder: How did Saturday's workday go from your side?
feedback.copy: Copy a message to let them know
timeline.help: One line per year, from the themes in your letters.
timeline.none: Your timeline starts with your first shared letter.
myteam.help: As a team lead, you can read the letters shared with your team.
myteam.none: No letters shared with your team yet.
voice.title: A question from {hui}
voice.who: Your name, or how you know {name} (optional)
voice.thanks: Mahalo nui. Your words will help {name}.
voice.used: This link has already been used. Mahalo!
voice.closed: This review has closed. Mahalo for your time.
voice.help: Your answer goes to {director} at {hui}. It is shared with {name} only as part of a letter about their work.
feedback.message: Aloha {name}, I asked you a quick question in our review app. You can answer it on your page: {link}
feedback.copied: Asked. A message to let them know is copied, ready to paste.
landing.askDirector: Lost your link? Ask {director} for a fresh one.
feedback.emailed: Asked. We emailed {name} a link to answer.
open.title: See how reviews are run
open.body: Nothing about the admin side is hidden. Watch the same walkthrough {director} uses, or read the step by step guide: how reviewers are picked, what {director} can and cannot see, and how each letter is written.
landing.adminBody: Admins sign in with their email. A one time code arrives by email, and you stay signed in for the day. Only people on the admin list can get in. Staff never need this: your own link is all you need.
landing.adminIn: You are signed in as an admin.
landing.adminAlsoStaff: You are on the People list too, so you can open your own reviews without a link.
